motions.description: Approve all items on the Consent Agenda (items a through x, excluding item y which was removed).
Recuse Trustee Conte from voting on the raffle application submitted by the Women's Auxiliary of the Regular Republican Voters League of Leyden Township.
Approve the raffle application submitted by the Women's Auxiliary of the Regular Republican Voters League of Leyden Township for their Chicken Bingo fundraiser at Elmcrest Banquets on June 2, 2026.
Approve a raffle application submitted by Sandy Sugg, Secretary of the Grand Chamber by O'Hare, to hold a Split the Pot fundraiser at the Circle Car Show on June 12th.
Approve a proclamation submitted by President Saviano for the 100th Anniversary of Frank's Barbershop at 7308 W Grand Ave, Elmwood Park.
Approve the recommendation from the Traffic and Safety Commission to designate diagonal spots on 76th Avenue and 76th Court as Staff Parking School Days 7am-4pm at John Mills School.
